item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 25/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Relatively humid easterly airstreams will affect the coast of eastern Guangdong in the next couple of days. There will be mist patches. It will be warm during the day. With a southerly airstream gradually affecting the coast of southern China early next week, it will be hot with one or two showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the vicinity of southern China next week, bringing unsettled weather to the region. There will be thunderstorms over inland areas.
